what: Profit AI — profit analytics + marketing automation for Shopify. Launched Dec 2025, reached $30k MRR on app + ~$40k services in ~5 months, total $147k revenue.
why_us: Clear vertical AI/SaaS success in e-commerce analytics with fast growth and services upsell; strong signal for Shopify-adjacent tools.

what: Lancer — AI agent that automates Upwork client acquisition for freelancers. Weekend MVP → $10k MRR in 60 days, now ~$20k MRR with 2-person team.
why_us: Classic AI agent/automation play solving real freelancers' sales pain; rapid monetization validates demand for vertical outreach agents.

what: Pingo AI — language learning / social AI app. Cleared $7M revenue, currently ~$600k months with small team focused on marketing + product.
why_us: Shows saturated niches still work if UX/fun is better; high absolute revenue for consumer AI.

what: Strong recurring demand for simple subscription audit / cancellation tools and offline-first / privacy-first local apps. Multiple analyses of thousands of ‘I wish there was an app’ posts highlight subscription fatigue and local-first needs.
why_us: SaaS sprawl and price increases create ongoing pain; micro-tools that list/cancel unused subs or offer local alternatives have clear willingness to pay.

what: Job search app that searches along public transport routes instead of radius distance. Also requests for streaming tools aggregator and iMessage agents app store.
why_us: Niche but concrete mobility + job-search pain; low competition for transit-aware filters.

what: AI wrappers surviving and profitable again in 2026: median $18k MRR, 62% gross margin for vertical workflow tools (not pure chat). Examples include LinkedIn outreach (PROSP $128k MRR).
why_us: Confirms vertical thin AI + specific deliverable still works; pattern for new wrappers.
